editorial.meta_description: The CCS Certified Construction Specifier exam from the Construction Specifications Institute evaluates professional expertise in project documentation.
editorial.overview: The Certified Construction Specifier credential, offered by the Construction Specifications Institute, focuses on advanced specification development and project documentation. The exam covers six distinct knowledge domains, including production, coordination, and procurement. It assesses professional capabilities to translate design narratives into technical documents, manage project manuals, and ensure alignment with contract requirements for the modern construction industry across exactly 120 multiple-choice questions within 180 minutes.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is strictly intended for experienced architects, engineers, construction managers, and professional specifiers who actively work with complex project manuals, specifications, and professional construction documentation in their daily practice.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the Construction Specifications Practice Guide and the Project Delivery Practice Guide. Utilize the official study materials for practice questions and exercises. Join an online study group through the organization website after registration. Contact your local chapter for potential study groups or prep programs to support your exam preparation and ensure you are ready for the 120 questions.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses on the planning and organization of project specifications, including managing complex production schedules and maintaining version control to ensure all documentation meets industry standards for professional construction project delivery.

This section covers the coordination of specification information across various project team disciplines and the verification of contract requirements to ensure that all documentation remains consistent throughout the entire project delivery process.

This domain addresses procurement, contracting, and general requirements, including the coordination of Division 01 and the implementation of substitution procedures to ensure payment and measurement specifications are defined for the project.

This area centers on the research process required for selecting appropriate materials and systems while identifying applicable code requirements and industry standards necessary to maintain compliance in construction project documentation.

This domain involves the detailed analysis and evaluation of systems, materials, and constructability to ensure full compliance with the original design intent while also incorporating value engineering reviews to optimize project outcomes.

This final domain focuses on the professional production of project manuals, translating complex design narratives into clear specifications and organizing documents according to established formats to facilitate efficient communication and project success.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam is a computer-based test administered at authorized Prometric centers. Arrive early for your testing appointment and ensure you have your Authorization To Test email and required identification documents ready for check-in to begin your session.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The CCS certification exam consists of exactly 120 multiple-choice questions. These questions are designed to test your knowledge of construction specifications, project delivery methods, and the coordination of technical documentation required for professional practice.

The organization does not publish a specific passing score for this exam. The certification process uses a structured analysis for the full population of test takers, with official results sent after the testing window closes.

Candidates are provided with 180 minutes to complete the 120 questions on the exam. It is recommended that you manage your time effectively during the session to ensure sufficient opportunity to review your answers.

faq.question_title: How do I renew my certification?
faq.answer_text: Check with Construction Specifications Institute for the current certification path, renewal criteria, continuing education unit policies, and specific requirements needed to maintain your active credential status over time.

methodology.summary: This editorial was compiled by reviewing official candidate handbooks and verified exam documentation to ensure accuracy regarding exam structure, domain weights, and professional requirements for all prospective candidates seeking this credential.
